india.one_line: India sees AI focus on green data centres, regulator guidelines, and data‑privacy compliance.

themes.title: ReNew builds green AI data centre
themes.text: ReNew Energy Global announced an investment of about ₹80,000 crore to construct a 1 GW green hyperscale data centre and clean‑energy manufacturing facilities in Andhra Pradesh, aimed at supporting the country’s digital economy and AI workloads.

stories.headline: ReNew pledges ₹80,000 cr for green data centre and manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh

themes.title: Regulators tighten AI rules
themes.text: The Securities and Exchange Board of India will issue AI usage guidelines for capital markets that require disclosures, accountability and a human‑in‑the‑loop approach, while the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology launched a portal for companies to register as consent managers under the DPDP Act, setting a ₹2 crore net‑worth threshold.

stories.headline: Sebi to issue AI usage guidelines for capital markets focusing on investor protection
MeitY opens DPDP Act consent manager registration portal
